newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Kinshasa team for talks to be known shortly-radio.
newsitem.headline: Kinshasa team for talks to be known shortly-radio.

text.p: Zaire will announce its team for talks with Laurent Kabila's rebels in the coming days, state radio reported on Monday.

The radio gave no precise date for the talks but referred to "talk of a possible first meeting" in South Africa before the end of the week. Rebel spokesman in the east have said the talks could be as early as Thursday.
"There is talk of a possible first meeting between the representatives of the rebellion and those from Kinshasa towards the end of the week in South Africa," the radio said.
"In Kinshasa we should know within the coming days the names of the personalities who will make up the committee of negotiators," it added.
The rebels took up arms in October, vowing to topple veteran President Mobutu Sese Seko, who has dominated the sprawling Central African nation since seizing power in 1965.

Mobutu has asked parliament to appoint a seven-member negotiating team representing government, the judiciary, the opposition, his own presidential movement and with a special representative from the presidency to take charge of the talks.
